200.answer: Pay-per-view events air at specific times. You can order programming up to 24 hours in advance, and for major events, it may be extended to 72 hours. Once ordered, a Pay-per-view event cannot be cancelled or refunded.

snippets.text: # Using Pay-per-view About Pay-per-view  - collapsed Pay-per-view events air at specific times. You can order Pay-per-view programming up to 24 hours in advance. For major events, it may be extended to 72 hours. You can still order Pay-per-view programming after it has started, up until the half-way point. However, you will not be able to restart it. Please note that once a Pay-per-view event is ordered, it cannot be cancelled or refunded. With Fibe TV  - collapsed You can order up to 72 hours prior to the event. You will need your TV PIN (personal identification number) to complete the order. By default the PIN is 1234. If you changed it and can’t remember it, you can [change your PIN](https://m.bell.ca/supportpine)in MyBell. Channels * English:  993-994 * French:  190-191 Order from your TV * Within 24 hours of the programming, go to the desired channel on your TV. * Select the movie or event you want to order. * Press  Select . * Follow the instructions on your screen to purchase or rent it. Locking rentals Prevent accidental rentals or purchases by setting a parental control PIN. * With your Bell remote, press the Menu button. * Select Settings -> Parental controls -> Rental locking . * Enter a 4-digit PIN. * Confirm your PIN. * Select Lock renting . * Scroll to and select Save . Order online * On your computer, visit [fibetv.ca](https://tv.bell.ca/home). * Log in using your MyBell username. * In the guide, scroll to the movie or event you want to order. * Click on the play button and follow the instructions. With Satellite TV  - collapsed You can order up to 72 hours prior to the event. To watch the event, tune in with the receiver you used to place the order. Channels * Events : 831, 832, 399 (French: 1788-1789) Order from your TV Make sure your receiver is connected to a phone line. Whole Home receivers must be connected to the Internet. * Tune in to the desired  channel . * Scroll to the movie or event you want to order. * Press  S
